# Load libraries

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(clustree)
library(scater)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(egg)
library(workflowr)
library(here)
library(sessioninfo)

source(here("code", "helper_functions.R"))
source(here("code", "load_colour_schemes.R"))

RERUN_ALL <- FALSE
```

# Prepare the datasets for annotation

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
object <- here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC_ALL_optimised_ref.Preprocessed_merged.Seurat.rds")

if (!file.exists(object) | RERUN_ALL) {
  # load in datasets
  sce_data1 <- readRDS(here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC_01_optimised_ref.Preprocess.SCE.rds"))
  sce_data3 <- readRDS(here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC_03_optimised_ref.Preprocess.SCE.rds"))
  sce_data4 <- readRDS(here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC_04_optimised_ref.Preprocess.SCE.rds"))
  sce_data5 <- readRDS(here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC_05_optimised_ref.Preprocess.SCE.rds"))
  
  # add in batch information
  sce_data1$Dataset <- "dataset_01"
  sce_data3$Dataset <- "dataset_03"
  sce_data4$Dataset <- "dataset_04"
  sce_data5$Dataset <- "dataset_05"

  # distinguish between the cell names of each dataset (prevents duplicate names)
  colnames(sce_data1) <- paste0("01_", colnames(sce_data1))
  colnames(sce_data3) <- paste0("03_", colnames(sce_data3))
  colnames(sce_data4) <- paste0("04_", colnames(sce_data4))
  colnames(sce_data5) <- paste0("05_", colnames(sce_data5))
  
  # identify genes in common between the datasets
  common_genes <- Reduce(intersect, list(rownames(sce_data1),
                                         rownames(sce_data3),
                                         rownames(sce_data4),
                                         rownames(sce_data5)))
  
  sce_data1 <- sce_data1[common_genes,]
  sce_data3 <- sce_data3[common_genes,]
  sce_data4 <- sce_data4[common_genes,]
  sce_data5 <- sce_data5[common_genes,]
  
  sce <- SingleCellExperiment(list(counts = cbind(counts(sce_data1),
                                                  counts(sce_data3),
                                                  counts(sce_data4),
                                                  counts(sce_data5))),
                              colData = data.frame(
                                Sample = c(sce_data1$Sample,
                                           sce_data3$Sample,
                                           sce_data4$Sample,
                                           sce_data5$Sample),
                                Dataset = c(sce_data1$Dataset,
                                            sce_data3$Dataset,
                                            sce_data4$Dataset,
                                            sce_data5$Dataset),
                                Barcode = c(sce_data1$Barcode,
                                            sce_data3$Barcode,
                                            sce_data4$Barcode,
                                            sce_data5$Barcode)))
  
  # create Seurat object
  seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts(sce),
                                     meta.data = data.frame(Sample = sce$Sample,
                                                            Dataset = sce$Dataset,
                                                            Barcode = sce$Barcode,
                                                            row.names = colnames(sce)))
  
  seu$Donor <- ifelse(seu$Sample %in% c("1AFa", "1AFb"), "1AF", seu$Sample)
  
  saveRDS(seu, object)
} else {
  seu <- readRDS(object)
}
```

```{r}
seu$Donor.Paper <- unname(DONOR.PAPER[seu$Donor])
seu$Donor.Paper <- factor(seu$Donor.Paper)

seu$Sample.Paper <- unname(SAMPLE.PAPER[seu$Sample])
seu$Sample.Paper <- factor(seu$Sample.Paper)
```

```{r}
dim(seu)
```

# *Celltypist* annotation

*Celltypist* uses a logistic regression classifier to transfer cell type labels based on an in-built pan-foetal reference dataset that contains cells from a variety of tissues, including foetal skin.

*Celltypist* was run via command line using the pan foetal reference model and majority voting options.

## Prepare dataset for annotation with *Celltypist*

```{r}
# extract counts matrix from Seurat object
object <- here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC_ALL_optimised_ref.Preprocessed_merged.Counts.csv")
if (!file.exists(object) | RERUN_ALL) {
  seu_counts <- GetAssayData(seu[["RNA"]], "counts")
  write.csv(seu_counts, object)
}
```

## Load in results from *Celltypist*

```{r}
object <- here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC_ALL_optimised_ref.Celltypist_annotated.Seurat.rds")
if (!file.exists(object) | RERUN_ALL) {
  # Add the pan_fetal reference results
  predicted_labels <- read.csv(here("celltypist", "output_ALL_optimised_ref_pan_fetal", "predicted_labels.csv"))
  probability_matrix <- read.csv(here("celltypist", "output_ALL_optimised_ref_pan_fetal", "probability_matrix.csv"))
  decision_matrix <- read.csv(here("celltypist", "output_ALL_optimised_ref_pan_fetal", "decision_matrix.csv"))
  
  predicted_labels <- createCelltypistResultsDF(predicted_labels, probability_matrix, decision_matrix, 
                                                ref_name = "pan_fetal")
  
  predicted_labels <- predicted_labels[colnames(seu),] # reorder to ensure names match Seurat object
  
  seu <- AddMetaData(seu, predicted_labels)
  
  # Add the pan_fetal reference results
  predicted_labels <- read.csv(here("celltypist", "output_ALL_optimised_ref_fetal_organ", "predicted_labels.csv"))
  probability_matrix <- read.csv(here("celltypist", "output_ALL_optimised_ref_fetal_organ", "probability_matrix.csv"))
  decision_matrix <- read.csv(here("celltypist", "output_ALL_optimised_ref_fetal_organ", "decision_matrix.csv"))
  
  predicted_labels <- createCelltypistResultsDF(predicted_labels, probability_matrix, decision_matrix, 
                                                ref_name = "fetal_organ")
  
  predicted_labels <- predicted_labels[colnames(seu),] # reorder to ensure names match Seurat object
  
  seu <- AddMetaData(seu, predicted_labels)
  
  # convert labels into sorted factors
  seu$pan_fetal.predicted_labels <- sortedFactor(seu$pan_fetal.predicted_labels)
  seu$pan_fetal.majority_voting <- sortedFactor(seu$pan_fetal.majority_voting)
  seu$fetal_organ.predicted_labels <- sortedFactor(seu$fetal_organ.predicted_labels)
  seu$fetal_organ.majority_voting <- sortedFactor(seu$fetal_organ.majority_voting)
  
  # add in metadata
  meta <- read.csv(here("data", "workflow", "dataset_meta.csv"))
  rownames(meta) <- meta$donor
  meta$dataset <- NULL
  meta$donor <- NULL
  meta <- meta[seu$Donor,]
  rownames(meta) <- colnames(seu)
  seu@meta.data <- cbind(seu@meta.data, meta)
  
  seu$Donor.gest_age <- factor(seu$Donor, levels = c("4AF", "8AF", "6AF", "5AF", "1AF", "7AF", "2AF"))
  seu$Donor.early_mid_late <- ifelse(seu$gest_age_weeks == 20, "Mid Gestation",
                                     ifelse(seu$gest_age_weeks < 20, "Early Gestation",
                                            "Late Gestation"))
  
  saveRDS(seu, object)
} else {
  seu <- readRDS(object)
}
```

```{r}
seu$Donor.Paper <- unname(DONOR.PAPER[seu$Donor])
seu$Donor.Paper <- factor(seu$Donor.Paper)

seu$Sample.Paper <- unname(SAMPLE.PAPER[seu$Sample])
seu$Sample.Paper <- factor(seu$Sample.Paper)

seu$Donor.gest_age <- factor(seu$Donor.Paper, levels = c("AF_3", "AF_7", "AF_5", "AF_4", "AF_1", "AF_6", "AF_2"))
```

### Examine labels after majority voting

Majority voting involves overclustering the dataset and assigning the same cell type label within these clusters based on highest vote.


### Examine labels after majority voting

Majority voting involves overclustering the dataset and assigning the same cell type label within these clusters based on highest vote.

```{r}
# labels after majority voting
table(seu$fetal_organ.majority_voting)
```


```{r, fig.asp=2}
  scale_color_manual(values = c(ALL_CELL_TYPE_COLOURS)) +

  geom_text(stat = "stratum", size = 2, check_overlap = TRUE) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("predicted_labels", "majority_voting")) +
  ylab("Number of cells")
```
